title: The reply-discipline examples state expected replies, judged in use
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. 0145 withdrew the reply-discipline round, but its examples remain with the design's examples.
decision: The reply-discipline examples stay as the statement of how the architect's replies are expected to read. No cut realizes them; they are judged in use (0142).
